message:
A few years ago, we got caught in a surprise winter storm that turned our cozy little town into a snow globe overnight. I remember staring out at the swirling snowflakes, wondering how I’d entertain the grandkids without their usual distractions. So, I gathered some blankets, made a big pot of hot cocoa, and we turned our living room into a fort. 

We spent the afternoon playing board games, telling stories, and watching the snow pile up outside. It was such a sweet reminder that sometimes, a little storm can turn into a delightful family adventure. 

What’s your go-to cozy activity when the weather keeps you inside? ☕️
